01 · SURFACE WOUND

It passed the demo. It failed the citation.

A flagship assistant shipped a “research mode” that produced fluent footnotes. Journalists repeated the footnotes. Three of the five sources did not exist. The company called it a rare hallucination. The eval suite had rewarded confident formatting.

On the other tray: a retrieval-locked lab notebook that refuses to answer without a source chunk. Slower. Less beloved in screenshots. Zero invented papers in 90 days of logged use.
